construction.name: complete_rectangular_prism_column_return
construction.proof:
COMPLETE RECTANGULAR COLUMN RETURN
15 October 2026

The preceding octagonal face-contact return produced 63 complete owners
in nine square-footprint columns, with seven owners per column. Preserve
that unequal-phase return separately. The following regular-phase product
is a second complete geometry with the same ideal enclosure, and transfers
the physical mechanism to every prism height.

Let R be the fixed proper frame that aligns an actual prism side-face
normal with the x axis. For regular 8- and 12-prisms this is the specified
rotation pi/k from their canonical vertex-to-x frame. For the other prism
families retain the canonical frame. No frame is selected by a metric
search. Let l_j <= (Rv)_j <= u_j be rigorous bounds for every vertex v of
the complete canonical prism. Put m_j=(u_j+l_j)/2 and choose the rational
cell width W_j strictly greater than u_j-l_j. Convexity places the whole
owner R P - m strictly inside its axis-parallel cell of widths W_j.

For positive integers A,B,C, put complete owners at
  c(i,j,k)=((i-(A-1)/2)W_x,(j-(B-1)/2)W_y,(k-(C-1)/2)W_z)-m
for 0<=i<A, 0<=j<B, 0<=k<C. Distinct index triples differ in a coordinate,
so the corresponding open cell interiors are disjoint and their complete
owners are strictly separated in that coordinate. Every owner lies in the
box A W_x by B W_y by C W_z, hence in a cube of side
  S=max(A W_x,B W_y,C W_z).
The enclosing cube has the common center 0. Deleting any explicit subset
of whole owners preserves both properties and retains all boundary costs.

For ideal prism widths w_x,w_y,w_z the same construction has nominal
capacity floor(S/w_x)floor(S/w_y)floor(S/w_z). Its only changes occur at
the explicit events S=m w_j. Taking the first event with capacity>=N is
an exact finite consequence of the product construction, not a packing
optimality claim. The witness generator uses outward rational W_j and
checks the complete native geometry afterward.

This is a classical rectangular product packing. PingYou Ltd supplies
the new finite assemblies and complete certificates that improve the
pinned current prism records; no invention of Cartesian-product packing,
of the regular polygon, or of the infinite contact lattices is claimed.
These assemblies use no published finite donor packing. Current record
authors remain in the separately retained baseline witnesses.

The unequal-phase octagonal source return and this equal-phase grid must
not be identified as the same marked continuation state. Both survive in
the record tree. No density or global optimality statement follows here.
construction.source_cell_rule: Each complete rotated owner lies strictly inside its assigned cell. Distinct grid words are separated in their first differing coordinate.

This batch contains 31 fresh campaign cases, distinct from our earlier submissions: 10 improvements beyond the pinned current nominal/reference bounds and 21 improved complete certificates from physical source operations. Twenty certificate cases retain explicitly known nominal values; PR12L1.5/cube N24 conservatively claims only a reduced complete certificate. No new ideal bound is claimed for those 21 cases.

The constructions use marked cap exchanges and common separator returns, whole-child collar and height transfers, cross-base whole-prism inclusion and axial subdivision, complete prism self-host enclosure, and marked Catalan returns. Complete source owners, inherited author credits, frames, all host walls, pair separators, and the relevant common restoration paths are retained. The 75-dodecagonal-prism construction, for example, comes from 25 complete octagonal source prisms through a certified whole-envelope inclusion and three-child axial partition; its certified cube side is 10.834711256138021, below the retained bound of 11. Fixed-contact stress certificates and local frame results retain their stated scope; no global optimum is claimed.
